$comment: Rules of the form 'while this flag holds, this foe is not met in this area'. The adventure has exactly one: the Cave entrance's Ogres 'go out hunting for travellers once a day', so they are absent by night (I-45), and night is what the gourd sets. The shape is here rather than in the engine so a second adventure can state its own absences without a code change.
title: The 5 Treasures: absences
label: reading

records.text: The Ogres go out hunting for travellers once a day, so by night the Cave entrance is theirs no longer.
